key_concepts: Energy is the ability to do work and makes things happen.
Energy can be transferred from one object to another without changing form.
Energy can be transformed from one form to another.
The Sun is the principal source of energy for Earth.
Light energy is associated with the emission of visible light.
Light energy can cause changes such as lighting a room and photosynthesis in plants.

Heat energy can cause changes such as cooking food, melting ice, and heating a room.
